name: Yondoshi Holdings Inc.
summary: Yondoshi Holdings Inc. engages in the planning, manufacture, wholesale, and retail of jewelry, apparel, bags, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company offers jewelry products primarily under the 4°C name. It also plans, designs, and manufactures men's and women's wear and luxury watches. In addition, the company engages in the operation of fashion specialty stores and real estate leasing activities. Further, it is involved in managing a network of apparel specialty stores under Pallet brand.
